notes: NCore 11.7.127: Screen sharing opens a Go Live window: pick a quality preset, then what to share. Your ping now shows in milliseconds in calls and voice channels, even while you're muted or alone. The deafen button is now a headset, and deafening mutes your microphone too (voice channels included). The profile and status popup is simpler and works like Discord: click a status to switch instantly, click your custom status to edit it, and copy your user ID. Discovery has been removed for now while it's rebuilt. Fixed garbled characters in the voice connection details panel.
